cases.prompt: Revise this industrial fault-diagnosis manuscript from scientific positioning through experiments, LaTeX verification, and author handoff.
这个课题同时写了非平稳、多模式、图网络和迁移学习，请先区分工程问题与方法并选择论文主线。

My draft mixes channel dependency, graph learning, missing observations, and fault localization. Separate the industrial challenge, method, task, object scale, and evidence before selecting a paper archetype.
Map the industrial-process literature, verify the cited papers, and construct a defensible gap for the Introduction.
我只有一个生产过程问题和几个模块想法，请先形成问题-设计-证据蓝图和贡献点。
Structure a method paper in which a controlled benchmark supports detailed mechanism tests and an actual production process supports engineering relevance.
从电熔过程、三相电流与视频采集链出发，推导异常工况识别论文的方法和实验。
Audit split leakage, comparison fairness, ablations, sensitivity, class-wise metrics, and which claims these results support.
不要改正文内容，保持表格字号，修复浮动体位置，逐页检查 PDF 并整理 Overleaf 上传包。
Polish the Abstract and Introduction while preserving formulas, results, citations, table sizes, and author voice.
请按工程应用顶刊标准审稿，问题优先并按严重程度列出，不要直接重写。
Fix the authentication bug in this React application.
帮我检查这封私人邮件的语法。

Build and prioritize a portfolio of several AI-for-engineering research candidates from our verified corpus and available data. Calibrate contribution tracks and overlap across papers before choosing one.
请根据已核查的文献和可用数据批量整理研究候选，校准创新层级、验证成本与跨论文重复风险，先排研究组合的优先级。
We have selected one fault-diagnosis idea and its data scope. Develop only this paper into a problem-design-evidence blueprint and contribution statement. Do not generate a portfolio.
我们已经选定一个故障诊断课题，数据范围也确定了。只把这一篇写成问题—设计—证据蓝图和贡献陈述，不再批量选题。
Only fix grammar and terminology in this engineering-paper paragraph. Preserve its scientific scope, citations, and claims; do not search the corpus or generate ideas.
只润色这篇英文工程论文摘要的语法和术语，保留科学内容、引文和结论；不扩展选题，也不读取整套文献库。
Prepare a point-by-point response to the editor and reviewers using the revised manuscript and verified additional results.
请根据审稿意见、修改后的英文稿和真实补充实验，逐条写回复信并核对修改位置。
We selected one engineering study whose contribution is a new task formulation using a standard classifier. Build the manuscript argument and evidence architecture.
只改这段英文工程论文的语言，去除空泛防御措辞，保留引文、条件和实测结果，不改变研究方案。
